title: Nchar-Ngrilled Fil-Pi Lan Tinola
description: A tangy, juicy brunch-mood Filipino dish featuring grilled filipino meat with chilli and high-protein ingredients in a light broth for a nutritious twist.
instructions: Clean and marinate the fil-pi with water, chili flakes, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Heat a grill or frying pan. Grill the fil-pi on medium-high heat until charred and cooked through.
Add water to a pot and bring it to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes with optional garnish like lime juice.
Place grilled fil-pi in individual plates and serve hot over the broth.
Serve with your choice of side dishes such as steamed rice, mango salsa or pickled vegetables.
